provenance.method: Loaded and answered Inpaint at fp16: one ordinary Load, then two Inpaint requests (warm-up, timed) through Arsenal's API. test night 1 Nov 2026: quiet Mac (idle check before each reading). Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.

peakMemoryGB.basis: Load and two Inpaint requests on a short fixed test input.

provenance.method: Sum of macOS phys_footprint_peak over all Arsenal worker processes (only the measured model was loaded) across one ordinary Load, then two Inpaint requests (warm-up, timed) through Arsenal's API; MiB converted to GB (10^9 bytes). test night 1 Nov 2026: quiet Mac (idle check before each reading). Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.

secondsPerRequest.basis: One warm Inpaint request on a short fixed test input.
